subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 22, 2026
body:
**October 22, 2026 AcreetionOS Newsletter**

**Breaking News: AcreetionOS 1.0 Reaches New Milestone with Calamares Customization**

We are thrilled to announce that our team has made significant progress in customizing Calamares, the universal Linux installer, for AcreetionOS. Cobra3282000 has successfully implemented a new feature that forces Wayland as the default desktop environment, ensuring a seamless user experience. This achievement marks a major milestone in our journey to create a user-friendly, privacy-focused Linux distribution.

**Community News**

* Our community has been actively contributing to the project, with several new commits and pull requests. We appreciate the dedication and enthusiasm of our community members, including @cobra3282000, @natalie, and others.
* The PHP Foundation has released a new security update, and we're working to ensure that AcreetionOS remains secure and up-to-date.

**Practical Tip: Secure Your System with AcreetionOS**

To ensure the security and integrity of your AcreetionOS system, make sure to regularly update your packages using the `sudo pacman -Syu` command. This will keep your system up-to-date with the latest security patches and bug fixes.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community!
